trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Aegean Bliss Resort, Disney World, Orlando, Florida

day_by_day.morning: No activities — flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities — flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Take Disney's Magical Express or a budget rideshare (Uber/Lyft) to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, unpack, and get settled. Pick up a resort map and plan your week. Get to bed early to maximize Day 2 energy.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: On the plane or airport food court
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night snack at the resort's lobby convenience store or vending area upon arrival — keep it light and budget-friendly

day_by_day.notes: Pre-purchase your Disney park tickets online before arrival to save time and potentially money. Download the My Disney Experience app. Set alarms early for Day 2. Confirm resort check-in details in advance since arrival is late night.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early and head to Magic Kingdom — the crown jewel of Disney World. Arrive at rope drop (park opening, typically 9:00 AM) to beat the crowds. Hit top rides first: Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. Use the free Disney Lightning Lane Single Pass strategically if budget allows.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom. Visit Fantasyland for family-friendly rides like Peter Pan's Flight and The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh. Watch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (check daily schedule). Take a mid-afternoon break at the resort if needed to avoid peak heat and crowds, then return refreshed.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the evening. Watch the iconic Happily Ever After fireworks spectacular over Cinderella Castle (check schedule — typically around 9:00 PM). Enjoy the park atmosphere with lower crowds after dinner. Head back to resort via Disney transportation (free Disney buses from Magic Kingdom).

meals.breakfast: Quick-service breakfast at the resort or grab a granola bar and fruit from a grocery stop — budget tip: bring snacks from a nearby Walmart or Publix
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — try the Lobster Roll or Clam Chowder Bread Bowl; budget-friendly quick-service with great value
meals.dinner: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland — one of the best quick-service values in Magic Kingdom with burgers, chicken, and rotisserie options under $15

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable walking shoes and bring sunscreen, a refillable water bottle (free water at quick-service locations), and a portable phone charger. Magic Kingdom is the most popular park — arriving at rope drop is essential for budget travelers to maximize time without purchasing Genie+ add-ons.

day_by_day.morning: Head to EPCOT for a full day of exploration. Arrive early and go straight to World Discovery for Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue — join as soon as the park opens via the app). Then experience Test Track and Mission: SPACE for space-themed thrills.
day_by_day.afternoon: Stroll through World Showcase — visit international pavilions including Mexico, Norway (Frozen Ever After ride), China, Japan, and France. Enjoy free cultural entertainment, street performers, and architecture. Browse merchandise but stick to window shopping to stay on budget. Visit the Canada Far and Wide CircleVision film — free with park admission.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's LUMINOUS The Symphony of Us nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check schedule). This is one of Disney's most beautiful free-with-admission shows. Grab a budget-friendly treat before heading back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Pack breakfast from resort or grab a quick bite at resort food court before heading out
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — excellent quick-service with rotating healthy options, soups, sandwiches, and grain bowls for around $12–$16
meals.dinner: Katsura Grill in the Japan Pavilion — quick-service Japanese food including teriyaki, sushi rolls, and udon noodles at very reasonable prices for Disney

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is a walker's park — you'll cover several miles. The World Showcase doesn't open until 11:00 AM, so use the morning for Future World/World Discovery rides. Bring a reusable bag to carry snacks. Budget tip: split a large entree between two people at quick-service locations to save money.

day_by_day.morning: Visit Hollywood Studios for a Star Wars and entertainment-packed day. Arrive at rope drop and head immediately to Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance — one of the most impressive theme park attractions ever built. Then ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. The early morning is the best time for these high-demand rides.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Toy Story Land — ride Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Watch Fantasmic! (check showtimes — evening show, but grab a dining package if budget allows, otherwise join the standby line early). Visit the Animation Courtyard and watch Disney Junior shows. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular for free thrills.
day_by_day.evening: Watch Fantasmic! — Hollywood Studios' spectacular nighttime lagoon show featuring beloved Disney villains and heroes. Arrive 45–60 minutes early for good seating (free with park admission). After the show, head back to the resort and rest up for another big day.

meals.breakfast: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — fun quick-service with breakfast options like the Totchos (tater tot nachos) and S'more French Toast Sandwiches, great value
meals.lunch: ABC Commissary — one of the best-value quick-service spots in Hollywood Studios with burgers, wraps, and salads in a cool air-conditioned setting
meals.dinner: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge — themed quick-service with unique dishes; try the Smoked Kaadu Ribs or Fried Endorian Tip-Yip (chicken) for a memorable but affordable meal

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios often reaches capacity on summer days — arrive early. The Lightning Lane for Rise of the Resistance sells out fast; join the virtual queue at exactly 7:00 AM via the app (before park opens). Consider packing a small cooler with drinks and snacks in a locker to save significantly on beverages.

day_by_day.morning: Take a well-deserved resort day and explore the Aegean Bliss Resort amenities. Enjoy the beachfront area, pools, and resort grounds. Sleep in a bit to recharge. This is a great budget day since you're using what you've already paid for at the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Disney Springs — completely free to enter, no park ticket required! Explore the shopping, dining, and entertainment district. Browse the World of Disney store (the largest Disney merchandise store in the world), check out the LEGO store, and enjoy the lively atmosphere along the waterfront. Watch street performers and enjoy the ambiance.
day_by_day.evening: Continue at Disney Springs for dinner and evening entertainment. Catch a movie at AMC Disney Springs 24 (budget-friendly compared to park entertainment) or enjoy free live music at various venues throughout the complex. Take the free Disney bus back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Resort food court — enjoy a full hot breakfast to fuel the relaxed day; look for combo meal deals
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs — gourmet burgers with creative toppings at reasonable prices; try the seasonal special
meals.dinner: Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza at Disney Springs — build-your-own artisan pizza for around $10–$12, one of the best budget dining values at Disney Springs

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free admission and a fantastic budget-friendly option. Parking is also free at Disney Springs if you drive. This rest day is strategically placed mid-trip to prevent theme park fatigue, especially important for families with children. Use this day to do laundry, repack bags, and review remaining park days.

day_by_day.morning: Spend the day at Animal Kingdom — Disney's largest park by area. Arrive at rope drop and head straight to Pandora – The World of Avatar. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage (one of Disney's most popular rides — expect long waits if not there early) and Na'vi River Journey. The floating mountains and bioluminescent theming are stunning even in daylight.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa and Asia sections of the park. Take the Kilimanjaro Safaris for an authentic wildlife experience — morning and afternoon rides offer different animal activity. Walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for free up-close wildlife viewing. Ride Expedition Everest in Asia for a thrilling roller coaster experience. Watch the Festival of the Lion King show — a spectacular live performance included with admission.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the evening transformation of Pandora — the bioluminescent lighting at night is absolutely magical and worth the wait. Watch Rivers of Light or check for any scheduled nighttime events. Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks, so plan accordingly and head back to the resort for a good night's rest before the final park day.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at the resort before heading out — pack portable snacks like granola bars, apples, and trail mix to save money throughout the day
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — one of the best quick-service restaurants in all of Disney World with healthy grain bowls, proteins, and unique beverages at fair prices ($14–$17)
meals.dinner: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — excellent open-air BBQ restaurant with ribs, chicken, and pulled pork at great value; enjoy waterfront seating with beautiful views

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced over a full day. The park is very walkable but covers enormous ground — wear your most comfortable shoes. Bug spray is recommended, especially near the water areas. The Kilimanjaro Safaris is best in the early morning or late afternoon when animals are most active. Check the My Disney Experience app for wait times throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: Return to your favorite park for final rides and experiences — Magic Kingdom is recommended for a nostalgic farewell. Use the morning to hit any rides you missed or want to experience again. Pick up any last souvenirs — budget tip: check the Emporium on Main Street USA for clearance and sale items, or visit Character Premier Collectibles for unique finds.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy a final leisurely lunch in the park. Take photos at iconic locations: Cinderella Castle, the Partners Statue (Walt and Mickey), and Main Street USA. Soak in the atmosphere one last time. Check out of the resort (confirm checkout time) and store luggage with the bell services if your flight is later in the day.
day_by_day.evening: Head to Orlando International Airport with plenty of time before your departure. If time allows before heading to the airport, grab a final Florida-style meal near the resort or airport area. Reflect on an incredible week of Disney magic on a budget!

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — treat yourself to a slightly nicer resort meal to celebrate the end of a great trip; many resorts offer character dining but book in advance if desired
meals.lunch: Casey's Corner on Main Street USA, Magic Kingdom — classic American hot dogs, corn dog nuggets, and fries in a nostalgic baseball-themed setting; one of the most affordable and beloved spots in the park
meals.dinner: Airport dining or a nearby Denny's/IHOP near the airport for a budget-friendly final Florida meal before flying home

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your flight details and airport transportation early in the morning. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before departure for airport security during summer peak season. Use any remaining Disney gift cards or dining credits before leaving. Take the free Disney Magical Express or pre-book a rideshare to the airport. Don't forget to check the resort room thoroughly before checkout — it's easy to leave items behind after a busy week!

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival at 22:30
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival at 22:30
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport via Flight UA at 22:30. Take Disney's Magical Express or a rideshare to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, unpack, and get settled into your Beachfront room. Pick up any essentials from the resort shop.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the airport before departure
meals.dinner: Grab a light late-night snack at the resort's lobby bar or 24-hour quick-service option upon arrival

day_by_day.notes: Given the 22:30 arrival, prioritize rest tonight. Download the My Disney Experience app, link your park tickets, and make any remaining dining reservations before sleeping. Set an early alarm to maximize Day 2.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure — Arrive at rope drop (park opens ~9:00 AM). Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin before crowds build. Use Lightning Lane for top-tier attractions. Explore Fantasyland and ride Seven Dwarfs Mine Train mid-morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Magic Kingdom exploration — Visit Adventureland for Pirates of the Caribbean and Jungle Cruise. Catch the Festival of Fantasy parade (typically around 3:00 PM) from a shaded spot on Main Street U.S.A. Take a mid-afternoon break back at the resort if needed (only ~15–20 min away) to cool off and recharge.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the evening — Experience Big Thunder Mountain Railroad and Haunted Mansion with shorter wait times after dinner. Stay for the Happily Ever After fireworks spectacular (typically ~9:00 PM). A must-see highlight of the entire trip.

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast at the resort before heading out — grab pastries and coffee at the resort café
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — mid-range counter service with clam chowder, fish & chips, and sandwiches (~$15–$20/person)
meals.dinner: Liberty Tree Tavern in Liberty Square — classic American comfort food in a colonial setting; book in advance (~$40–$55/person)

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass in advance through the My Disney Experience app. Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen, a portable fan, and a refillable water bottle. June in Orlando is hot and humid with afternoon thunderstorms possible — pack a small poncho.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios & Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Immersion — Arrive at rope drop and head immediately to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge. Join the virtual queue or purchase Individual Lightning Lane for Rise of the Resistance, the park's most immersive ride. Visit Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber (~$249.99 — optional splurge worth booking in advance).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the rest of Hollywood Studios — Pilot the Millennium Falcon at Smugglers Run. Transition to Toy Story Land for Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Visit the Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster in Sunset Boulevard. Catch a showing of Fantasmic! (check schedule — usually evening but afternoon shows sometimes available).
day_by_day.evening: Fantasmic! Nighttime Spectacular — If not caught in the afternoon, watch the stunning water, fire, and projection show at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater (typically ~8:00–9:00 PM). Head back to the resort afterward and wind down at the beachfront area for a relaxing nightcap.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the resort buffet to fuel up before rope drop
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — fan-favorite counter service with grilled cheese, BBQ brisket melts, and tots (~$12–$18/person)
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant — unique drive-in movie themed dining experience with burgers, pasta, and shakes (~$35–$50/person); reservations strongly recommended

day_by_day.notes: Book Savi's Workshop lightsaber experience well in advance — slots fill up months ahead. The Oga's Cantina in Galaxy's Edge is a fun Star Wars bar experience; reservations are required and highly recommended (~$15–$25/person for drinks and snacks).

day_by_day.morning: Resort Relaxation Morning — Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely morning at Aegean Bliss Resort. Take advantage of the beachfront amenities — swim in the pool, walk along the waterfront, or enjoy a resort activity. This intentional rest day recharge is essential mid-trip, especially in summer heat.
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT World Showcase Cultural Food Tour — Arrive at EPCOT around noon. Begin the World Showcase food tour traveling counterclockwise. Sample dishes from Mexico (street tacos, margaritas), Norway (school bread, salmon), China (egg rolls, Peking duck), Germany (bratwurst, pretzels), Japan (sushi, gyoza), and more. Use EPCOT's festival booths if a seasonal festival is running in June.
day_by_day.evening: EPCOT Future World & EPCOT Forever — Explore Future World attractions including Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (book Individual Lightning Lane) and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France pavilion. Stay for the EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (~9:00 PM).

meals.breakfast: Relaxed resort breakfast — order room service or dine at the resort restaurant at your own pace
meals.lunch: World Showcase grazing lunch — budget ~$30–$40/person sampling small plates and snacks across multiple country pavilions
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo in the Japan Pavilion — interactive hibachi-style teppanyaki dining with skilled chefs; great for families (~$45–$65/person); reservations required

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT frequently hosts seasonal festivals in June (EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival or Flower & Garden Festival depending on the year — confirm dates for 2027). Festival booths offer additional food and drink sampling opportunities perfect for the food tour experience.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience — Arrive early for Kilimanjaro Safaris (best wildlife activity in the morning when animals are most active). See lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, and more in an open-air vehicle. Follow up with the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail walking trail through lush habitats.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pandora – The World of Avatar — Head to the Avatar Flight of Passage (book Lightning Lane — one of Disney's most popular rides). Experience the Na'vi River Journey for a gentler, visually stunning boat ride. Explore the bioluminescent landscape of Pandora. Visit DinoLand U.S.A. for DINOSAUR ride and check out Discovery Island trails.
day_by_day.evening: Rivers of Light or Tree of Life Awakening — Watch the Tree of Life come alive with animal spirits projected onto its surface at dusk (approximately every 10–15 minutes after dark). Catch Rivers of Light nighttime show if scheduled. Return to the resort for a relaxing beachfront dinner or evening stroll.

meals.breakfast: Grab-and-go breakfast at the resort — pack snacks and a water bottle for the safari morning
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — one of Disney's best quick-service restaurants with healthy grain bowls, protein options, and creative beverages (~$15–$22/person)
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Asia — Asian-fusion cuisine with pan-seared duck, ahi tuna, and Mongolian beef in a beautifully themed setting (~$35–$55/person); reservations recommended

day_by_day.notes: Kilimanjaro Safaris is significantly better in the morning — animals are active and visible. Bring a camera with a good zoom lens. Avatar Flight of Passage has one of the longest wait times in all of Walt Disney World — Lightning Lane purchase is strongly advised. The park typically closes earlier than Magic Kingdom.

day_by_day.morning: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Morning — Enjoy a late, relaxed start. Head to Disney Springs for a mid-morning brunch and explore the unique shopping district. Visit The LEGO Store, World of Disney (largest Disney merchandise store in the world), and browse the artisan marketplace. No park ticket required — free admission.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort Leisure Afternoon — Return to Aegean Bliss Resort for an extended afternoon of beachfront relaxation. Enjoy resort pools, watersports, or spa services if available. This is a perfect opportunity to recharge before the final full park day. Alternatively, revisit a favorite park for a half-day using any remaining Lightning Lane credits.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening — Return to Disney Springs for dinner and evening entertainment. Explore the waterfront entertainment venues, catch live music at the Marketplace Stage, and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere. Browse specialty shops and enjoy the festive summer evening ambiance.

meals.breakfast: The Daily Poutine or Amorette's Patisserie at Disney Springs — light pastries and coffee for a relaxed start (~$10–$15/person)
meals.lunch: Chicken Guy! by Guy Fieri at Disney Springs — casual and affordable hand-crafted chicken tenders with creative dipping sauces (~$12–$18/person)
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs — upscale waterfront dining with fresh seafood, steaks, and stunning amphicar tours; mid-range splurge night (~$50–$75/person); reservations recommended

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is open until 11:00 PM and offers a fantastic no-ticket entertainment option. Saturday evenings can be very crowded — arrive at The BOATHOUSE right at your reservation time. Consider booking an Amphicar Water Tour (~$125/vehicle) for a unique 20-minute experience on the water.

day_by_day.morning: Final Morning — Magic Kingdom or EPCOT Revisit — Choose your favorite park for one final morning visit. Arrive at rope drop to maximize time before checkout. Ride any missed attractions or revisit personal favorites. Pick up last-minute souvenirs at park gift shops or Main Street U.S.A.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort Checkout & Departure Prep — Return to Aegean Bliss Resort by noon for checkout. Store luggage with the bell desk if your flight is later in the day. Enjoy one final swim or beachfront moment. Head to Disney Springs for any last-minute souvenir shopping if time permits before heading to the airport.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Orlando — Transfer to Orlando International Airport. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for Disney area traffic, check-in, and security. Reflect on an incredible 7-day Disney World adventure!

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — sit-down meal at the resort restaurant to celebrate the trip's end (~$20–$30/person)
meals.lunch: Quick-service meal at the park or Disney Springs before checkout — Earl of Sandwich at Disney Springs is a great affordable option (~$10–$15/person)
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Orlando International Airport or on the plane

day_by_day.notes: Request a late checkout from Aegean Bliss Resort in advance if your flight departs in the evening — many resorts accommodate this for an additional fee or as a loyalty perk. Disney's luggage forwarding service may be available to send bags directly to the airport. Keep all park tickets, MagicBands, and the My Disney Experience app accessible throughout the trip for seamless entry.

meals.lunch: N/A – In-flight or en route
meals.dinner: Late-night in-suite dining: Order from the resort's 24-hour premium room service menu. Recommended: Pan-seared filet mignon with truffle butter, roasted asparagus, and a glass of Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon.

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange private airport transfer through the resort's concierge before departure. Request early check-in preparation so the suite is fully stocked and ready upon arrival. Pack light carry-on essentials for comfort during the late arrival. Set out park tickets and MagicBands/Disney MagicMobile passes for the next morning to avoid delays.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure – Begin with a VIP Tour Guide experience at Magic Kingdom. Arrive at rope drop (park opens ~9:00 AM) to enjoy minimal wait times on classics like Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and the Haunted Mansion. Use Lightning Lane Premier Pass to skip queues on all major attractions. Stroll down Main Street U.S.A. and catch the opening welcome show.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the Magic Kingdom Full Day Adventure – Head to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and 'it's a small world.' Explore Tomorrowland and Adventureland. Enjoy the Festival of Fantasy Parade (typically ~3:00 PM). Take a mid-afternoon break at the resort's private club lounge or a shaded area with cold refreshments to avoid peak heat.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the spectacular Disney Enchantment nighttime spectacular and Magic Kingdom's fireworks show over Cinderella Castle. Secure a premium reserved fireworks viewing package for front-row views with dedicated seating, dessert, and beverages included.

meals.breakfast: In-resort breakfast at the Aegean Bliss Resort's signature restaurant – Enjoy a lavish buffet or à la carte options including smoked salmon eggs Benedict, fresh tropical fruit, and freshly squeezed juices.
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant (Magic Kingdom, Fantasyland) – Dine inside the Beast's enchanted castle. Recommended: Braised pork with mushroom ragout or pan-seared salmon. Reserve well in advance via Disney dining reservations.
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table (Magic Kingdom, inside Cinderella Castle) – A once-in-a-lifetime premium dining experience with character meet-and-greets. Enjoy a prix-fixe menu featuring dishes like filet mignon, pan-seared chicken, and decadent desserts. Reservations essential – book 60 days in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Premier Pass for Magic Kingdom to maximize ride time. Wear comfortable, breathable clothing – June in Orlando is hot and humid (expect 90°F+/32°C+). Apply SPF 50 sunscreen and stay hydrated throughout the day. The VIP Tour can be booked through Disney's private VIP tour services for $450–$900/hour (minimum 7 hours) and includes a dedicated guide and front-of-line access.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios & Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Immersion – Arrive early at Hollywood Studios for a full Galaxy's Edge experience. Begin with Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run for an interactive piloting adventure. Then head to Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance, one of Disney's most immersive rides. Book Savi's Workshop – Handbuilt Lightsabers (reservation required, ~$249.99 per lightsaber) for a premium, ceremonial lightsaber-building experience in a private, atmospheric workshop.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the rest of Hollywood Studios – Ride Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania in Toy Story Land. Experience the Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith for thrill seekers. Catch a live performance of 'For the First Time in Forever: A Frozen Sing-Along Celebration' or the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular for family entertainment.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening – Head to Disney Springs for a relaxed, no-admission-required evening of world-class dining, live entertainment, and luxury shopping. Browse flagship stores including the LEGO Store, World of Disney, and high-end boutiques. Enjoy live music along the waterfront promenades.

meals.breakfast: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant (Hollywood Studios) – A unique, immersive breakfast experience inside a 1950s-style drive-in movie theater. Enjoy classic American breakfast plates while watching vintage sci-fi clips on a giant screen.
meals.lunch: Oga's Cantina (Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge, Hollywood Studios) – The ultimate Star Wars bar experience with unique themed cocktails, non-alcoholic drinks, and light bites. Reservations are highly recommended and spots fill within minutes of opening.
meals.dinner: Morimoto Asia (Disney Springs) – Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship restaurant offering Pan-Asian cuisine. Recommended: Peking duck (whole duck, carved tableside), wagyu beef gyoza, and a premium sake or cocktail pairing. A truly elevated dining experience.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop reservations open 60 days in advance for Disney resort guests – book immediately upon check-in or before arrival. Each guest builds one custom lightsaber; it makes an exceptional keepsake. The Droid Depot (also in Galaxy's Edge) offers custom droid building as an additional activity (~$119.99) if time permits. Use Disney's Skyliner gondola system for seamless transportation between resorts and parks.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Cultural Food Tour – Arrive at EPCOT at opening and begin with Future World (now called World Discovery and World Nature). Ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane required) and Test Track. Head to World Showcase as it opens (~11:00 AM) and begin a curated culinary journey through the 11 country pavilions. Start in Mexico (tequila flights and street tacos at La Cava del Tequila) and move through Norway, China, Germany, and Italy.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the EPCOT World Showcase Cultural Food Tour – Progress through the American Adventure, Japan (matcha soft-serve, sake tasting at Takumi-Tei), Morocco, France (crêpes and macarons), the United Kingdom, and Canada. Consider booking the EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival experiences if visiting during the festival season. Ride Frozen Ever After in the Norway Pavilion and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France Pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's stunning nighttime spectacular 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Luminous The Symphony of Us' (confirm current show schedule). Secure a premium IllumiNations or Harmonious Dining Package at one of the World Showcase restaurants for reserved waterfront viewing with dinner included.

meals.breakfast: The Garden Grill Restaurant (EPCOT, The Land Pavilion) – A rotating, family-style character dining experience featuring Mickey, Pluto, and Chip 'n' Dale. Enjoy farm-fresh American cuisine including turkey, mashed potatoes, and seasonal vegetables sourced from The Land's greenhouses.
meals.lunch: Via Napoli Ristorante e Pizzeria (EPCOT, Italy Pavilion) – Authentic Neapolitan wood-fired pizzas in an elegant trattoria setting. Try the Quattro Formaggi or the signature Via Napoli pizza with San Marzano tomatoes and fresh mozzarella. Pair with a glass of Italian Barolo.
meals.dinner: Takumi-Tei (EPCOT, Japan Pavilion) – EPCOT's most exclusive and intimate dining experience. An omakase-inspired Japanese menu featuring Wagyu beef, sashimi platters, and artfully crafted seasonal dishes. The refined, minimalist interior reflects traditional Japanese craftsmanship. Reservations are extremely limited – book at the 60-day window.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase is massive – wear comfortable walking shoes and use the complimentary resort transportation to arrive refreshed. The Food & Wine Festival (typically August–November) and Flower & Garden Festival (March–July) may overlap with your June visit, adding extra food booths and entertainment. Carry a refillable water bottle and take advantage of EPCOT's free water stations. Lightning Lane Premier Pass is highly recommended for Cosmic Rewind.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience – Arrive at Animal Kingdom at rope drop for the Kilimanjaro Safaris, the park's most popular attraction. An early morning safari offers the best wildlife activity as animals are most active in cooler temperatures. Spot lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, hippos, and more in their expansive, naturalistic habitats. Follow with the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for up-close encounters with lowland gorillas and exotic birds.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Pandora – The World of Avatar – Immerse yourself in the bioluminescent world of Pandora. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage (a breathtaking, soaring banshee ride – Lightning Lane strongly recommended) and Na'vi River Journey for a serene, visually stunning float through a mystical rainforest. Take time to explore the incredible environmental details of the Valley of Mo'ara. Visit the Discovery Island Trails and DinoLand U.S.A. for additional family activities.
day_by_day.evening: Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks – transition to a luxurious resort evening. Return to Aegean Bliss Resort for a premium spa experience (book a couple's massage or a signature body treatment at the resort spa). Then enjoy a sunset cocktail hour on your beachfront suite balcony before heading to dinner.

meals.breakfast: Tiffins Restaurant (Animal Kingdom) – Disney's most prestigious Animal Kingdom dining venue, celebrating the art of travel and exploration. Enjoy a sophisticated breakfast with dishes like smoked salmon flatbreads, avocado toast with poached eggs, and artisan pastries in an art-gallery-like setting.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen (Animal Kingdom, Pandora) – A quick-service gem with surprisingly elevated food. Try the cheeseburger pods, slow-roasted grains bowls, or the signature Pandora-inspired beverages. A great mid-park fuel stop.
meals.dinner: Tiffins Restaurant (Animal Kingdom) – Return for dinner to experience the full menu. Recommended: Whole-fried sustainable fish, pan-seared lamb chops, or the signature Tiffins bread service with house-made accompaniments. The wine and cocktail list is exceptional. Request a table near the Nomad Lounge terrace for ambient waterfront views.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom typically closes by 8:00–9:00 PM, making it a shorter park day. Use the extra evening time for resort amenities – the spa, pool, or a private cabana experience. Avatar Flight of Passage consistently has the longest waits in the park (60–120+ minutes standby) – secure Lightning Lane Individual selection immediately at 7:00 AM on the day of your visit. Bring insect repellent for the outdoor trails.

day_by_day.morning: Resort Leisure Morning & Private VIP Experiences – Take a well-deserved slow morning at Aegean Bliss Resort. Enjoy a private beachfront breakfast on your suite terrace. Then participate in one of Disney World's exclusive premium add-on experiences: book the 'Disney's Keys to the Kingdom' backstage tour of Magic Kingdom (~$109/person, 5 hours) for a fascinating behind-the-scenes look at the park's underground tunnels, history, and operations. Alternatively, book the 'Wild Africa Trek' at Animal Kingdom for a private guided walking safari over rope bridges above hippo pools and crocodile lagoons.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Magic Kingdom or EPCOT for a lighter, relaxed afternoon of any missed attractions or favorite repeats. Alternatively, enjoy Disney's Typhoon Lagoon or Blizzard Beach water parks for a refreshing afternoon escape from the heat. Both water parks offer premium cabana rentals for a luxurious, shaded experience with dedicated attendants, food service, and private locker facilities.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell Celebration Dinner – Reserve an ultra-premium, special occasion dining experience to celebrate the trip. Enjoy a private fireworks viewing experience from a reserved location or a dessert party package. Spend the final full evening soaking in the magic of Disney World with a leisurely stroll through the park or resort grounds.

meals.breakfast: Private in-suite breakfast delivered by resort room service – Suggested: Eggs Benedict with smoked salmon, fresh-cut seasonal fruit platter, Belgian waffles with berry compote, freshly brewed specialty coffee, and fresh-squeezed orange juice.
meals.lunch: Narcoossee's (Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa) – A beloved waterfront fine dining restaurant with stunning views of the Seven Seas Lagoon and Magic Kingdom. Enjoy fresh seafood including Maine lobster, jumbo shrimp cocktail, and pan-seared scallops. Take the Disney resort monorail or boat for a scenic, premium arrival.
meals.dinner: Victoria & Albert's (Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa) – The crown jewel of Walt Disney World dining and one of Florida's most acclaimed restaurants. A AAA Five Diamond, Forbes Five-Star experience featuring a multi-course prix-fixe tasting menu (~$295–$350/person, wine pairing additional) with tableside preparations, a dedicated sommelier, and an intimate atmosphere limited to just 90 guests per evening. Reservations open 60 days in advance and are among the hardest to secure at Disney World – book immediately.

day_by_day.notes: Victoria & Albert's has a strict dress code: men must wear a jacket (tie optional), women in formal attire. Reservations must be made at exactly the 60-day mark as they sell out within minutes. The Chef's Table experience (~$250–$350 additional surcharge) offers a private kitchen-side dining experience for the ultimate culinary immersion. Wild Africa Trek must be booked in advance and has weight/health restrictions – confirm eligibility before booking.

day_by_day.morning: Relaxed Departure Morning – Enjoy a final leisurely breakfast at the resort. Pack and prepare for checkout. Arrange a late checkout with the resort concierge (typically available for premium suite guests) to maximize your final hours. Take one last stroll along the beachfront or enjoy a final dip in the resort pool. Visit the resort gift shop for any last-minute souvenirs or Disney keepsakes.
day_by_day.afternoon: Optional Half-Day Disney Springs Visit – If your departure flight allows, spend a final few hours at Disney Springs (no park ticket required). Browse the World of Disney flagship store for premium merchandise, visit the LEGO Store for unique keepsakes, and explore luxury boutiques. Enjoy a final Disney dessert or coffee at Amorette's Patisserie, known for its stunning sculpted cakes and French pastries.
day_by_day.evening: Airport Transfer & Departure – Arrange a private luxury vehicle transfer from Aegean Bliss Resort to Orlando International Airport. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for check-in, security, and boarding. Depart with extraordinary memories of a world-class Disney World luxury experience.

meals.breakfast: The Grand Floridian Café (Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa) – A charming, upscale café serving a classic American breakfast. Try the Floridian French Toast with fresh berries, or the Eggs Floridian with crab cakes and hollandaise. A beautiful, relaxed setting for a final Disney morning meal.
meals.lunch: Chef Art Smith's Homecomin' (Disney Springs) – Celebrity chef Art Smith's beloved Southern comfort food restaurant. Enjoy buttermilk fried chicken with honey, hush puppies, and mac and cheese in a warm, festive atmosphere. Perfect for a casual, celebratory final lunch.
meals.dinner: In-flight or at the airport – If time permits before departure, enjoy a meal at The Edison or STK Steakhouse at Disney Springs for a premium pre-flight dinner. Alternatively, pick up artisan snacks and treats from Marketplace Co-Op at Disney Springs for the journey home.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm late checkout availability at least 48 hours before departure – premium suite guests at luxury resorts typically receive complimentary late checkout until 1:00–2:00 PM. Arrange airport transfer 24 hours in advance through the resort concierge. Orlando International Airport (MCO) is approximately 25–35 minutes from Disney World depending on traffic. Keep MagicBands as souvenirs – they can be customized and make wonderful mementos of the trip. Ensure all park photos from Disney PhotoPass are downloaded before leaving (included with Memory Maker, which should be purchased in advance).

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June 2026
